Package dev.relism.flash.ext.validation

Interface Validation

All Known Implementing Classes:
AvajeValidation, JakartaValidation, ProtovalidateValidation
public interface Validation
Verifies that a value satisfies the rules its own type declares.

An implementation wraps a validation library (flash-ext-validation-jakarta, flash-ext-validation-avaje, flash-ext-validation-protovalidate) and installs itself through module(dev.relism.flash.ext.validation.Validation). Several engines live in one application: each type a codec decodes is checked by the one engine that checks(java.lang.Class<?>) it, whatever the codec, so a request that breaks a rule is a 422 and never reaches a handler. What a rule means, which annotations exist and how they are enforced is the engine's business; this module knows only when to ask.

  • Method Details

    • verify

      void verify(Object value)
      Verifies value against its type's rules.
      Throws:
      ValidationException - 422, listing every rule the value broke

    • checks

      default boolean checks(Class<?> type)
      Whether this engine has rules for values of type, asked once per type at boot: a type no engine checks is decoded and handed over with no call at all. A type whose values may be of a subclass with rules (an interface, an abstract class) is one the engine checks. Every type by default.

    • describe

      default void describe(Constraints constraints)
      Declares what this engine's rules mean, for the published document.

      Called once per app, when the document is first built. Each engine speaks its own vocabulary — the jakarta constraints, its own annotations, both — and says so here; nothing in this module knows any of them. An engine that declares nothing still enforces; it just says nothing.

    • module

      static Module module(Validation engine)
      What an engine's module installs: the engine as a Validation, its checks on everything a codec decodes when flash-ext-serde is on the classpath, and its rules in the published document when flash-ext-openapi is. 
      
 @Override public void install(App app) {
     app.install(Validation.module(this));
 }
